responsibility: Implements pass 0’s discovery of the compilation-unit and nested block universe. It builds a tree of modules and procedures with per-block imported and local module lists, records source tokens and nesting levels, validates that end names match opening names, enters and leaves diagnostic scopes, registers outer program/definition/implementation modules and inner modules for the batch manager, and later replays that block tree so pass 1 can declare inner modules in the right scopes before full semantic construction.
same_name_distinction: This is the executable implementation behind P0SymBuild.def, building the pass-0 universe of module/procedure blocks, tracking imports and nesting, checking END-name matches, and replaying that structure for later passes.
